description: Adds the people you picked to a campaign, as Add to campaign on the Contacts page does, a draft included: each is checked against the campaign's safety rules and the answer names who was added, who was skipped and why. People added to a draft are counted in start_campaign's preview and get their first message when it starts; nothing is sent by adding (on a started campaign a step due today is drafted, never sent). confirmOverCap: true only when your person accepts going over today's cap (the answer says over_daily_cap with the numbers otherwise). Pass the same idempotency_key when retrying; a repeat adds nobody twice.

idempotency_key.description: Your id for this operation (8-128 of A-Z a-z 0-9 . _ : -). Reuse it on every retry of the same operation; use a new one for a new operation.

name: add_contacts_to_campaign
title: Add chosen contacts to a campaign
